entities.summary: "U Don't Know Me (Like U Used To)" is a song by American recording artist Brandy. It was written by Isaac Phillips, Paris Davis, Sean Bryant, Rodney "Darkchild" Jerkins, and Brandy for her second studio album, Never Say Never (1998). Production was handled by Jerkins, with additional production from Brandy.
